    # Partition zero keeps the incumbent minimum-cost broadcast tree.  Later

    usage = {}

    for partition in range(partition_count):

            def penalized_weight(u, v, data):
                """Price an edge by cost plus congestion from prior partitions."""
                base = float(data["cost"])
                prior = usage.get((u, v), 0)
                throughput = max(float(data.get("throughput", 0.0)), 1e-12)
                return base * (1.0 + prior / throughput)

>>>>>>> REPLACE

This keeps the exact incumbent tree for partition zero, then constructs at most
three additional route sets. Each alternative uses throughput-aware congestion
pricing based on edge reuse in earlier partitions, encouraging independent
cloud/network paths while preserving deterministic shortest-path behavior.
Validation ensures every destination remains reachable before an alternative is
accepted. Requested partitions beyond the four-route compute budget retain the
known-valid incumbent paths without adding unbounded search work.
